name: tauan-mods
description: Tauan's Claude Code mods: one /mods pane for all of them, plus Muninn (your ai-memory).

plugins.name: mods
plugins.description: One /mods pane with a tab per installed mod (fork of mvacoimbra/claude-mods-hub with a Muninn tab)

plugins.name: muninn
plugins.description: Muninn, Odin's raven of memory: your ai-memory in a /muninn pane and a /mods tab, with the last handoff, search, recent pages and a status-line count

plugins.name: huginn
plugins.description: Huginn, Odin's raven of thought: matches model and effort to each step, with effort skills (/huginn:deep, /huginn:quick, /huginn:max) that keep the prompt cache, Sonnet, Opus and Fable subagents for delegated work, a session-start policy and a status-line chip

plugins.name: cache-tax
plugins.description: Keeps the one-hour prompt cache warm during breaks and stops a cold send once. Warming costs tokens. (mvacoimbra fork, joins /mods)

plugins.name: skins
plugins.description: Tool rows, code/diff/table/Mermaid cards, a usage band and fifteen themes. (mvacoimbra fork, joins /mods)

plugins.name: filetree
plugins.description: IDE-style file tree that shows what Claude is doing and where. (mvacoimbra fork, joins /mods)

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: Progress bar and agents panel for subagents. (mvacoimbra fork, joins /mods)

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: Step through the file edits Claude made in the last turn, one diff at a time. (mvacoimbra fork, joins /mods)

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Holds risky shell commands and shows what they would change, with Proceed and Cancel. (mvacoimbra fork, joins /mods)

plugins.name: reflect-mod
plugins.description: Finds reusable corrections in short prompts and saves them to CLAUDE.md from a band above the prompt. (mvacoimbra fork, joins /mods)
